title: Choros Silo-Fleet Cell Registry
description: JSON Schema draft-07 for the machine-readable silo-fleet cell registry (tenancy ADR §10). One entry per isolated silo cell: tier, mode, migration version, endpoint, status. T-0069.

cells.description: Each element is one silo cell (isolated tenant contour). slug is unique across the fleet.

slug.description: Stable fleet-unique identifier for the cell.

tier.description: Tenant tier (governs isolation/compliance posture). See ADR §5/§12.

mode.description: Isolation mode. silo now; pooled deferred (ADR §5/§11).

migration_version.description: Migration stem the cell is provisioned to (e.g. 055_fix_mcp_tool_demo_tenant). Must exist in migrations/ and be the head of an appliable linear prefix.

endpoint.description: Where the cell is reachable (Tailscale/host:port or URL). Probing it for liveness/backup is a documented seam — never probed by CI (servers are not provisioned here).

last_backup_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last verified backup, or null if never. Populated by the centralized monitor (real source = endpoint probe seam).
